title: Language-Oriented Semantic Modeling for Target Language Extraction
abstract: arXiv:2611.26317v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Target Language Extraction (TLE) aims to isolate speech in a target language from multilingual mixtures. Existing approaches primarily rely on acoustic modeling with language identity labels, which provide only coarse categorical guidance. In this work, we propose a language-oriented semantic modeling framework that augments acoustic extraction with language-specific semantic representations. A pre-trained speech semantic model is adapted via language-aware prompt conditioning and parameter-efficient fine-tuning to generate target-language-focused semantic representations from the mixture. {These capture high-level semantic structure of the acoustics and they} are integrated into the extraction model to provide structured semantic guidance beyond identity labels. Experiments on the CommonVoiceMix dataset show that incorporating semantic representations consistently improves over acoustic-only baselines, achieving up to 1.16 dB SI-SDR gai

translated_title: 面向语言的语义建模用于目标语言提取
translated_abstract: 目标语言提取旨在从多语言混合语音中分离出目标语言的语音。现有方法主要依赖带有语言身份标签的声学建模，而这只能提供粗略的类别性指导。在本工作中，我们提出了一种面向语言的语义建模框架，通过语言特定的语义表示来增强声学提取。我们通过语言感知的提示条件化和参数高效微调，对预训练的语音语义模型进行适配，以从混合语音中生成聚焦于目标语言的语义表示。这些表示能够捕捉声学的高层语义结构，并被集成到提取模型中，从而提供超越身份标签的结构化语义指导。在CommonVoiceMix数据集上的实验表明，引入语义表示能够持续优于仅使用声学特征的基线方法，SI-SDR增益最高可达1.16 dB。
tldr: 该论文提出一种面向语言的语义建模框架，通过语言感知提示条件化和参数高效微调将目标语言语义表示融入声学提取模型，在CommonVoiceMix数据集上相比仅声学基线最高提升1.16 dB SI-SDR。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a language-oriented semantic modeling framework that augments acoustic extraction with target-language semantic representations adapted via language-aware prompt conditioning and parameter-efficient fine-tuning, achieving up to 1.16 dB SI-SDR gain over acoustic-only baselines on CommonVoiceMix.
